{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏文件树插件：会话/文件标签栏 + 懒加载文件树，按扩展名彩色图标、复制路径、发送给 Agent。A sidebar file tree plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Sessions/Files tabs, lazy tree, per-extension icons, copy-path and send-to-agent.","id":"gh:1335016437","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-sidebar-files","slug":"Fallen0543/dsh-sidebar-files","topics":["agent","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-ai","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh-patch","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏文件树插件：会话/文件标签栏 + 懒加载文件树，按扩展名彩色图标、复制路径、发送给 Agent。A sidebar file tree plugin for D"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eepSeek Harness: Sessions/Files tabs, lazy tree, per-extension icons, copy-path and send-to-agent."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-sidebar-files"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A sidebar file tree for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a **Sessions / Files** tab strip to the left sidebar "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"and an inline, lazy-loaded file tree over the active workspace — with per-extension brand icons, cop"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"y-path, and send-to-agent actions."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Hover a file row for two actions — **copy path** and **send to agent**:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Copy path"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Send to agent"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **Plugin status.** Built and verified against the published harness (`0.1.0-rc.6`, the `web` profi"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"le). It runs entirely as an out-of-tree bundle: the node half serves directory listings through its "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"own HTTP route, the browser half renders the tree. No core changes required."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Sessions / Files tab strip** injected below the New Session button (wide sidebar). The tree rend"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ers inline in the sidebar region — same presentation as the harness's own browsing surfaces.
- **Laz"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y listing**: one directory level is fetched on demand (the workspace root on open, a directory on fi"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"rst expand), through the plugin's own `GET /dsh-sidebar-files/list?path=…` route. Wire cost follows "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"what you actually open.
- **Per-extension icons**: 47 brand-style glyphs for common extensions (ts/j"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"s/json/yml/yaml/css/html/md/ico/png/zip/log/…), plus a generic document fallback. Icon path data fro"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"m Material Icon Theme (MIT, © Material Extensions 2025) — see LICENSE.
- **Hidden by default**: dot-"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"led names, `node_modules`, and `.git` are filtered out; the **显示隐藏项** toggle reveals them. `node_mod"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ules`/`.git` stay hidden until the toggle is on.
- **Row actions** (hover): copy path (with one-seco"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"nd "copied" feedback) and send the file to the current session's agent (a queued "please read this f"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ile" prompt).
- **Resilient fallback**: if the shell's sidebar structure is ever unrecognizable, the"},{"id":"p10s12","text":" plugin degrades to a footer action button + centered modal instead of the tab strip — never a blank"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" screen.
- **Bilingual** (中文 / English), following the harness locale."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Requires the `dsh` CLI (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`) and pnpm."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**What is a profile?** A *profile* is one runnable composition of the harness — a named instance wit"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"h its own set of plugins. Profiles live under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>` (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/web"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"`). `--profile <name>` tells the `dsh` CLI which instance to operate on; replace `<name>` with your "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"own (the classic example is `web`)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If a profile with that name does not exist yet, the command initializes it on first use. Restart the"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" harness with the same profile name and the **会话 / 文件** tabs appear in the sidebar:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> If the profile is a fresh one, also add the web app bundle first: `dsh plugin --profile web add @d"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"eepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.0-rc.6` (or use the built-in `web` profile template that ships with the C"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"eek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.0-rc.6` (or use the built-in `web` profile template that ships with the CLI)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Alternative installs"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Local checkout or prebuilt tarball (no registry needed):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"From GitHub (`github:Fallen0543/dsh-sidebar-files`) — fetches **sources**; the package's `prepare` s"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"cript then builds `lib/` from source, self-contained (no monorepo checkout needed). pnpm ≥10 refuses"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" to run a git dependency's `prepare` script until you allowlist it — copy the exact package key pnpm"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" printed into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"and re-run the `add`. Only allow packages whose source you trust, and prefer pinning a commit (`gith"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ub:Fallen0543/dsh-sidebar-files#<sha>`). Installing from npm or a tarball needs no build permission."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The browser bundle is a CommonJS closure-factory artifact (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({…})`) with"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" the harness's platform modules external, so it loads through the web shell's module table; CSS modu"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"les are compiled in with lightningcss."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one host row (`id: sidebar-files`) that mounts the node half.
- The nod"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e half (`src/index.ts`) registers a web-server route prefix `/dsh-sidebar-files`; `GET /list?path=` "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"lists one directory level (directories first, then files; bounded to the first 1000 entries) and ret"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"urns `{ path, entries, truncated }` — errors are 400 with a machine-readable code.
- The browser hal"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"f (`dsh.client` declaration, `./client` export) registers into the harness's `sidebar.footer.action`"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" slot, then locates the sidebar column at runtime from its own trigger button and injects the Sessio"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ns/Files tab strip and the inline tree region (see `src/client/sidebar-host.ts`). When the shell str"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"ucture is unrecognizable, the footer button + modal fallback takes over.
- The active workspace path"},{"id":"p28s9","text":" is derived from the session/workspace stores (current session's workspace, else recent, else first)"},{"id":"p28s10","text":" through selector hooks, exactly like the harness's own browsing surfaces."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE. File-type icon glyphs are derived from Material Icon Theme (MIT, © Material Exten"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"sions 2025); the attribution and copyright notice are preserved in `src/client/file-type-icons.tsx`."}],"truncated":false}
